name: Spoil Five
summary: Irish trick-taking game where the pot is won for taking 3 of 5 tricks, with an optional 5-trick spoil attempt.
rules_text: Played with 52 cards and chips. 2-5+ players are dealt 5 cards each in 3+2, trump is determined by the next card turned up. Holder of trump Ace may rob the trump, swapping any card for the turn-up, otherwise they must have dealer turn it down. If Ace is turned, dealer may take it after first trick. Eldest leads; must follow suit if able, else must trump if able (but 5, Jack of trumps and Ace of Hearts are exempt from being forced when a lower trump is led). Highest trump wins, otherwise highest of led suit. First to 3 tricks may claim the pot, or may declare to go for all 5 to win pot plus one chip from each opponent; if going for 5 fails they win nothing and pot rolls over. Ante one chip each hand.
